scenarios.title: This repository's commit format
scenarios.prompt: You fixed a bug in ticket #1234 on the branch `fix/1234-null-owner`. The change is in `src/commands/status.ts`. Commit it.

scenarios.title: A harness change reaches this repository in the same ticket
scenarios.prompt: Your ticket changes the generated instructions in `src/harness/agent-instructions.ts`. What else must this repository carry in the same ticket, and which commands regenerate it?

scenarios.title: A skill template edit and its dogfood copy
scenarios.prompt: You edited `scaffolds/skills-templates/tools/github-projects/SKILL.md`. Which copies of it must follow, and how do you update each?
scenarios.notes: The dogfood copy follows the template either by `cp` or by an edit with the agent's own file tool (the project's instructions ask for native file tools); what is checked is that it follows and that the .agents projection is regenerated, never hand-edited.
